files.reason: This lane's local checks for run_checks.py: the changed and new test modules (test_mode_binding, test_freeze_gates_fix, test_rehearsals) and lint_language over the two bound review files.

Lane freeze-gates-fix (glitch-f1's ruling (2) of Wed 21 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation; lane-reports/freeze-gates-fix-LANE.md) fixes six freeze-path checks already red at the accepted head 5457e75e, on the line with all 225 walks merged (dry/all-225, d5c0f798). Edits without transfer, recorded here only so the owners' fragments stay untouched: mode_binding.py (w8a-walk-layout), the pin compared with the record each harness writes (Codex: the rollout turn_context's approval_policy and sandbox_policy; Gemini: the launch argv, input side, since Gemini 0.64.0 writes no mode record); fixture_walk.py (w8a-walk-layout), run_tree_of reads the launch journals' cwd when the ledger has none; walk_regrade.py (live-harness-foundation), an absent nested_cli_calls key compared only as a derived 0; language-allowlist.json (w1a-cp1-scaffold), four excusals for the hash-bound native-readers/codex-review.md and gemini-review.md; tests/test_mode_binding.py (w7b-walk-wiring), M4-vendor and two witnesses; tests/test_rehearsals.py (w7d-rehearsals), R4.empty's committed-register leg reads the registered state; tests/test_build_draft.py (w5c-draft-ci), R9.sessions reads the registered sessions. S8 (glitch-f1's rulings on the lane's hand-back, 21 Oct 2026): fixture_walk.py (w8a-walk-layout), RECORDED_EXCEPTIONS, w023's one per-walk exception, printed whenever it applies; tests/test_box_integration.py (w7b-walk-wiring), the production native-reader registry read hermetically under the process guard (a call naming no study, or the study tree, reads an empty scratch study); tests/test_native_history_record.py and tests/test_native_reader_registration.py (live-harness-foundation) and tests/test_vendor_admission.py (vendor-admission), their pre-acceptance expectations moved to the registered state at 5457e75e (both readers registered, Javier's acceptance commit the last on each record), each unregistered road still asserted through a registry without the harness. prereg-draft.json (w8b-holdout-digests) is re-derived by build_draft.py in its own commit and carries no note. S9, a recorded departure (glitch-f1's ruling on the lane's S8 hand-back, 21-22 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation): round 4's identical copies of allowlist.py and allowlist-derivation.json are RETIRED and removed, with their two entries in COPIED.d/w1a-cp1-scaffold.json. Reasons: --allowedTools was retired for the box by C15-2 (claude_code_adapter.py:17); no round 4 walk's launch argv carries it (0 of 225); no check, grader or gate reads the file or driver_change.allowed_tools; allowlist.py --check is not a freeze_rehearsal command; ci.yml runs the check for round 3 only. Round 3's copies under evals/gap-study-3 are untouched. tests/test_scaffold.py (w1a-cp1-scaffold): ci_conclusion.py, an identical copy w1a still claims, stands in for allowlist.py in the copy-without-edited-entry case, so the four cases stay four. Also in S9: tests/test_freeze_shapes.py (vendor-admission), the committed-draft check names legs (i) and (ii) for both arms and requires leg (iii) to hold (both readers registered since 5457e75e); leg (iii)'s refusals stay bound on synthetic registries by FS-check and CHECK_WITNESSES. S10 (the lane review's MINORs m1-m3 and NITs): mode_binding binds the Codex rollout's turns to the walk's turn streams and reads the Gemini journals through gemini_adapter.submitted_mode (its launch-facts leg included, the invocation rebuilt from launch.json, the ledger and the transcript envelopes); fixture_walk refuses a linked journal and binds the exception by the line's sha256 alone; tests/test_mode_binding.py gains the two-snapshot, launch-facts, harness-field and linked-journal cases and the first-snapshot witness. S12 (athena's battery on 12e021d3): tests/test_walk_layout.py (w8a-walk-layout), L7's registers carry the committed register's walks. S13 (glitch-f1's ruling 2 on the S12 hand-back): tests/test_build_draft.py (w5c-draft-ci) memoises leak_grep.derive per process on exactly what it reads (the draft's leak_words and leak_context_excusals and each committed session's path, size and mtime), so the 225-session read runs once per process.

Lane freeze-gates-fix (glitch-f1's ruling (2) of Wed 21 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation; lane-reports/freeze-gates-fix-LANE.md): F2-runtree (fixture_walk's run tree from the launch journals, bound to the ledger's project) and F3-nested (walk_regrade compares only the fields the walk's checker version wrote), F4-exception (S8: w023's recorded exception bound to its line, never excusing a study path, never stale silently), with eight witnesses (S10 adds exception-excuses-leak and linked-journal-read, the lane review's survivors R4 and J4).
